entityName: 52°North Spatial Information Research GmbH
entityDescription:
The purpose of the 52°North Spatial Information Research GmbH is to develop, enhance and improve the use of geodata and geoinformation technologies in science, business and administration through applied research and knowledge-intensive services.The company acts as a link between research and practice in geoinformation processing and promotes cooperation between business, science and administration. It follows the principle of open science and makes its findings available to the widest possible circle of users in the form of open publications, open source software and open data.

52°North evaluates new macro trends, such as the Internet of Things, the Semantic Web or Linked Open Data, and paves the way for unfolding their use in practice. The 52°North team of geo-information scientists and skilled IT professionals contributes to research activities and provides professional services such as software development, consulting and training. 

The 52°North GmbH is a non-profit organization, i.e. the shareholders receive neither profit shares nor other payments from company funds. The Managing Directors are Dr. Benedikt Gräler, Dr. Simon Jirka, and Matthes Rieke.

entityName: Indeco Soft
entityDescription:
Indeco Soft is one of the leading software developer companies in Romania providing e-government solutions for over 1000 public administration institutions (cities, county counsels, schools, universities and private business). For over 15 years it’s innovating for the public administration putting into art new software products and helping, with the aid of technology, reducing the gap between the public administration in Romania and the citizens. We are constantly tackling with the need for better public services and software solutions while trying to keep an effective cost control, as budgets are limited and maximum budget efficiency is a must. 
The company’s software solutions include software specifically designed for the public administration, managing social care (social benefits, proceedings and workflows), local taxation and electronic payment, economics and finance (budgeting, HR management, accounting, and bills), investment and acquisition management, public relations and urban planning, document management and others. The quality of our services is certified by our numerous yearly contract renewals.
Indeco Soft is a privately owned independent business, in the Medium Enterprise category and has already gathered 15 years of experience working with and for the public administration. We have been part of a successful implementation of an ICT-PSP project – www.iscopeproject.net (CIP-ICT-PSP-2011-5), and acted as contractors in a large number of software implementation for projects funded out of Regional Development Funds in Romania.
The ICT-PSP I-scope project, successfully completed in 2015 aimed at providing an interoperable Smart City service through an Open Platform for urban Experts. i-SCOPE delivers an open platform on top of which it develops, three "smart city" services.
Indeco Soft’s expertise in working with the public administration and its continuous contribution in innovation in the public sector have conducted towards attempting to grow beyond the national barriers and innovate to a European level. Our team’s skills and know-how will successfully complete the challenge of bringing into art an innovation project that would benefit public authorities, citizens and business across Europe. 
Our eGovernment integration software – SIGMA® was prized as the best software product in Romania by the Romanian Association of Public IT Managers since 2005, and our tax payment integration solution – www.ghiseul.ro is the state of the art tax payment product in Romania. The tax payment solution was selected by a committee delegated by the Romanian Electronic Payment Processor’s Association (an association of banks, payment processors and facilitators, credit card operators, Visa Europe and Mastercard) after a best value for money analysis and promoted as a standard in Romania, finally being backed-up by legislation, due to an excellent implementation, proof of security and openness towards all taxation software providers in Romania, through open specification web services. 
Indeco Soft is a member of Aries Transilvania, an ICT Bronze Cluster Management Excellence labeled cluster – iTech Transilvania and of APERO (The Romanian Association of Electronic Payment Processors)
Our social responsibility targets energy efficiency through an app designed for consumption management for the public administration and eHealth, through an elder monitoring solution called EMOTIoN designed for heart-disease and cognitive impaired elders monitoring, based on independent smart-watches capable of GSM communication, positioning and heart-rate monitoring. The project’s relevance comes from the employment of mobile technologies and the need to tackle (both from the technical and regulations point of view) with the collection and protection of sensitive personal data – location, health state and identification.

entityName: Université LIBRE DE BRUXELLES - ULB
entityDescription:
Founded in 1834, Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB - www.ulb.be) has a long tradition of excellence in Research with 4 Nobel Prizes, 2 Nobel Peace Prizes, 1 Field Medal, 3 Wolf Prizes and 2 Marie-Curie Excellence Awards. It is one of the largest and best Research Universities in Belgium, with a student population of 30,000 and with almost 2,000 PhD in progress Distributed among 22 Doctoral Schools. ULB has considerable experience with European and International funding programmes.
Several Research Units of ULB are involved in ESA funded projects such as: Microgravity Research Center (MRC), the Transfers, interfaces and Processes (TIPs) laboratory, the Mathematics and Theorical Physics Department, the nonlinear Physical Chemistry Unit, the laboratory of Spectroscopy, Quantum Chemsitry and Atmospheric Remote Sensing, the Cardiology Center, Astronomy and Astrophysics Institute, the Interdisciplinary Center for Nonlinear Phenomena and Complex Systems.

entityName: AgriCircle AG
entityDescription:
AgriCircle is a leading provider of cloud field management solutions. We connect farmers to their professional environment. Our field management platform simplifies field advice and makes it easy to collaborate between agronomists, contractors and professional colleagues.
Through the use of modern technologies we developed decision support systems to simplify and sustainably improve cultivation. To accomplish this we connect actual field with remote sensing and other data sets like weather and more. By the use of real time decision support we want to augment productivity and improve efficiency on the fields.
AgriCircle has been established in August 2012 by Peter Fröhlich and Daniel Markward. The company is headquartered in Rapperswil, Switzerland with a subsidiary in Munich, Germany.

entityName: Politecnico di Torino
entityDescription: For more than 150 years, the Politecnico di Torino has been one of the most prestigious public institutions at both the International and the Italian levels concerning education, research, technological transfer and services in all sectors of architecture and engineering. The Politecnico di Torino was founded in 1859 as Scuola di Applicazione per gli Ingegneri (Technical School for Engineers), and it became Regio Politecnico di Torino in 1906. A long history, which bore out the University as a reference point for education and research in Italy and in Europe, a Research University of international level which attracts students from more than 100 countries and which activates about 800 collaborations per year with industries, public institutions and local organizations. The attention to theoretical and applied research, the knowledge and development of cutting edge technologies, the concreteness and realism concerning the management of a manufacturing process or the organization of a service, the care of functionality without ignoring design, the analysis and proposition of solutions to the challenges of the society of today in order to plan a sustainable future: graduates from the Politecnico di Torino receive an education that goes far beyond technical knowledge. They are able to manage the interdisciplinary nature of the scientific world of today without forgetting social, ethical, economic and environmental implications. Excellent results in education and research fields, positive judgments from students, education processes of quality and the ability in winning national and European grants brought the Politecnico di Torino to an excellent place in the assessment drawn up by the Italian Ministry of Education, Universities and Research (MIUR): since 2010, when the MIUR began to award the public funding of the Fondo di Finanziamento Ordinario according to a table on Universities performances, the Politecnico has always been the first University in Italy. A positioning proved by the good results of the University at the European level.

entityName: AROBS Transilvania Software
entityDescription:
Founded in 1998 in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, AROBS Transilvania Software is an important IT solution provider of ready to use systems and tailor made software based on the latest technologies. With a multinational team and 450 employees located in six centers nationwide, the company entered the Top 100 employers in Cluj County, ranking 5th in the top of the largest local IT employers. AROBS also has two service offices abroad, in Moldova and Hungary. The company addresses the IT needs of industries as diverse as travel, financial, automotive, and pharmaceutical with advanced and effective mobile Web, mobile, embedded, and cloud solutions. AROBS has continuously diversified its portfolio on multiple dimensions as the technologies covered, industries targeted, areas of application, and geography.
The solutions developed by AROBS streamlined and integrated business, production, service, and support processes for the customers. Several illustrative areas of application for our custom solutions are listed next:
•	Mobile applications: car navigation, information services, games, hotel booking, M-Health, location based services, messaging systems, Web sites
•	Embedded applications: vehicle onboard panel programming, car infotainment systems, building and office automation, automatic ticketing, vehicle safety systems, mobile navigation
•	Web solutions: enterprise (asset, workforce, content, customer relationship, and warehouse management,
•	resource planning, e-Commerce, business intelligence), travel applications (online booking, property, channel and review management, clinical trial management (IVRS, IWRS), e-Banking, traffic message channel (TMC) service
•	Cloud solutions: sales force automation, fleet tracking and management
The services provided by AROBS include the followings: research & development, architecture & design, product development, application migrations, application maintenance, customer support, quality assurance and testing, user interface and UX design and online marketing.

entityName: ASENSE NOVA, S.L.
entityDescription:
Asense Nova, SL specializes in optical engineering, design and fabrication for product development. We design and develop custom optoelectronic and optomechanical systems, precision optics and prototypes. With our rigorous systems approach and creative problem solving processes, we design optical systems that improve reliability and performance.
We help companies and institutions to improve their current instruments, incorporating optical turnkey systems. Whatever the design challenge, Asense Nova, SL can help delivering technologies with mission-critical performance. We can achieve the stringent specifications required by the high-end applications of our customers.
Research and development is at the core of Asense Nova SL's activities. We foster innovation through the innovative solutions we deliver to our clients by always bringing together the members of staff with the most relevant experience to any given project as well as allowing members of staff to develop their own ideas. The wide breadth of skills and differing backgrounds covered by our staff allows us to tackles many fields of both research and development.
From design to manufacturing, our expertise and core values allow us to serve and cover the needs in optical design, engineering and manufacturing across a broad range of applications areas: Astronomy, Aerospace, Defense & Security, Medical Devices, Life Sciences, Scientific Instrumentation, Imaging, Remote Sensing, Industrial and Automotive, Lighting and Illumination.

entityName: Pulse Power and Measurement Ltd
entityDescription: Pulse Power and Measurement Ltd (PPM) was founded in 1994 as a distributor of pulse power systems, power electronics components & EMC test equipment. In 1995 PPM began to manufacture RF over fibre equipment following the purchase of Electro Optic Developments Ltd. In 2001 PPM launched an RF over fiber platform designed for RF communications. “RF over fibre” systems allow RF electrical signals to be transmitted over fibre optic cables. PPM is a fully independent privately owned UK registered business, accredited to ISO9001:2008. In January 2014, PPM were awarded silver status by Investors in People. PPM now operates three distinct business units: ViaLite Communications: Manufacture and distribution of RF communications equipment, including RF over fibre links, RF switching, integrated antenna and filter solutions and digital RF receivers.PPM Power is a European distributor of pulsed power and power electronics equipment manufactured by our partners in the USA, Europe and Asia. PPM Test: Manufacture and distribution of specialist test equipment, including intelligent RF over fibre links and high voltage probes.

entityDescription:
LTS International Limited is a consultancy and project management firm that supports sustainable development worldwide. We thrive on tackling complex facets of climate change, forestry, water resources, ecosystems, landscapes, and institutional governance.

Since 1973 we have successfully completed 900 assignments across 100 countries in Europe, Africa, Asia and the Americas. We continue to provide our wide range of clients with information, insight and ideas across a range of technical disciplines.

Since October 2018, LTS International is owned by NIRAS Gruppen A/S (NIRAS Group), a Danish company. LTS International has offices in Edinburgh (UK) and Jakarta (Indonesia). entityName: SPARC: Space Applications and Research Consultancy
entityDescription:
Space Applications & Research Consultancy (SPARC) was established in 2016. SPARC is a group of physicists and engineers with established research experience in the fields of Data, Space, Nuclear, Plasma and Material Sciences. The interdisciplinary character of SPARC permits the development and provision of high-demanding tailored services in several fields. Our main activities are focused, but not limited, to space research and applications.
SPARC develops and provides:
- Data services and distribution
- Scientific data curation and processing
- Data analysis
- Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications
- Simulations of energetic particle detectors
- Data driven physics models
- Detection & forecasting of space weather events
- R&D Project Management
